## Props (MatrixPageProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sources` * | `MatrixSource[]` | Columns. |
| `rows` * | `{ trackId: string; artist: string; title: string; mix?: string; counts: Record<string, number> }[]` | Rows: a track and its count per source ID (absent = not played). |
| `coverage` * | `number[][]` | Key × energy coverage: 24 keys (1A…12B) × 10 energies. |
| `from` * | `IsoDate; to: IsoDate` | Period covered, for the description. |
| `onCellSelect` * | `(key: string, energy: number) => void` | Opens the library filtered to one heatmap cell. |
| `tab` | `"sources" \| "keys"` | Initial tab (?tab=). |
